provenance.notes: No third party: the passkeys are registered and checked on the site's server (WebAuthn, over web-auth/webauthn-lib, MIT) against the browser's authenticator; attestation 'none', so no metadata service (FIDO MDS) is fetched and nothing is called: no rate limit ([]), no key. The licence is the library's (MIT, its notice kept in vendor/ as Composer installs it). This file limits nothing; a sign-in's tries are omniauth's Throttle.
